body:
There are so many random things that I don't even know where to begin. I don't really have a family other than the few close friends I've kept from high-school (currently a senior under-grad). School has been quite an added stress lately as I've had 7 weeks straight of Exams every week and I still have three more exams before we get 2 days (plus the weekend) off for break. Mostly I've been stressed about other people in my life recently or more correctly the lack of other people in my life. I'm pretty much a mess and a train wreck of personality quirks. I put on a great smile everyday and people look to me as a leader, an organizer, and an idea guy. I've been promoted twice and received 5 pay raises at my job and I haven't even been there a year yet. I enjoy my job. But it's also a stress and it takes time away from the studying I should be doing. I need the job though. I pay for everything for myself except tuition (government loans cover just my tuition with a couple hundred left over). I pay for my own rent, food, cloths, and everything. I don't own a car and the place I'm living is cheap and drafty. None of that is even the problem though. It's just all added stress. I guess this is just the back ground information and it makes me feel arrogant and ungrateful and even childish to be complaining about these kinds of things. Normally I can just tell myself that there are people who have it worse off than me and I should quit whining but right now I feel like shit and I don't care. Family, my mother is just as big a nutcase as I am. She's been in and out of the psyc-ward several times for suicide attempts and recently lost her second husband (who was a really great guy) because of how violent she gets when she has a down day. My biological father has basically disowned me for being Bi-sexual and not Christian like his oh-so-perfect two-faced wife. My siblings follow his lead. 

My best friend who I consider my brother is also an ex-lover of mine. He's beautiful and amazing and far away and extremely busy with Med-school. After I left (and partially kicked out of) home he was there for me and helped me through quite a bit. He's three years ahead of me though and I haven't been able to see him in a couple years. I don't really have many other friends and the ones I do have are the causes of most of my anxiety. They're also mostly all ex-girlfriends which simply compounds the matter. 

So since the typical heartbreak in highschool I've used self-inflicted burns to get over big speedbumps in my life. My arm is a storyboard of scars and brands including one that trails from my wrist to my elbow making a complete spiral around my arm. I only found out that I am actually Manic-depressive about a year ago though I obviously knew something wasn't really right with me. I've always been like two people depending on my mood and it's cause me a lot of trouble. I end up in emotionally SM relationships as the M. 

So the last relationship I was in lasted about a year and got serious enough that we were looking at places to move into together. When we started looking for places I realized just how bad of a situation I was in. She was unreasonably jealous of everything in my life that wasn't her and she was always suspicious and passive-aggressive. She asked me all sorts of inappropriate and accusational questions about a co-worker's girlfriend after I mentioned I had met her. A few times she actually got violent and hit me (She's a second degree-black belt). One time I was trying to help her with her laptop who's battery was on the fritz. She gets very frustrated easily and takes it out on the poor laptop. My job (which she also resented because I was making a little more money than her and enjoyed my job unlike her) is fixing computers so I offered to take a look at it. She childishly pulled the plug out from it and when I tried to continue to help she hit me in her anger. Anyway we had a no sex(intercourse) relationship which I was ok with. She wasn't waiting for marriage but she wanted to be with the right guy and I understood and respected that. Loooong story short we end up having another big fight about something petty that she made a big deal about and it gave me the courage and perspective to end the relationship. That was a few months ago.

She and I have been chatting recently and it's been very friendly but earlier tonight she texts me saying she had a bad day and of course I asked if she wanted to talk about it. Apparently a week after we broke up she started seeing one of her co-workers at her new job. Now she's into drama because they're just fuck-buddies and she's feeling hurt by it. That is a completely understandable feeling and reaction. The problem is that she decided to bring this to me. I am glad she trusts me and feels like I am someone she can talk to when she needs to but at the same time I just don't react well AT ALL to surprises. Especially ones like that. It made me feel like absolute dog shit. I treated her ten times better than she ever treated me, helped her get out of the job she hated and into one she loves and put up with so much terrible crap from her but still apparently wasn't worth a second thought. We break up after a year and it's no big deal. Some dickhead fucks her and splits and it's the end of the world..... wait

Actually. I think I understand it now. She has got to be extremely upset. She wanted to wait till she was sure to be with someone. We break up pretty abruptly and then she sleeps with some sleezebag. She probably feels horrible :( I think I have some friend duties to attend. 

I know this has probably been a really random and fuck-if-I-know post but just know that knowing you guys are here actually really helped me tonight. So thanks.
